bee.v1.ObjectId.description: 34-byte object id: algorithm byte, kind byte, 32-byte digest (SPEC §3.1).
bee.v1.ObjectId.title: bee.v1.ObjectId

bee.v1.RepoRef.description:
Every repo-scoped request names its repo by id or by "org/name".

Oneof `repo`: at most one of `id`, `fullName` is set.
bee.v1.RepoRef.title: bee.v1.RepoRef

bee.v1.Revision.description: A revision expression: ref name, ref@version, changeset id or unique prefix.
bee.v1.Revision.title: bee.v1.Revision

meta.description:
Redact the Meta of the changesets named by `ids` (changeset ids in `ids` stand for their
Meta; blob ids stay blobs); with no changeset id, the Meta of the changeset at `at`.

path.description: Path form: redact the blob at `path` in `at`, or every version of it with all_versions.

purgeAfterSeconds.description: Seconds in quarantine before the scheduled purge; 0 = default (7 days) (SPEC §13).
